headline: The abyss remembers your treasure now
lede: SONAR ABYSS got a memory law for its prize: a pearl once heard keeps a faint glint on the black canvas until you collect it — the same doctrine that kept the exit glowing since #2367. Chasing the ghost through real-key testing also caught and cured the old nightlybot report #2589 at its root: fresh runs on certain seeds were being born already lit, inheriting the attract demo's mid-dive map because the shell flipped its mode after loading the cave instead of before.

notes.text: Pearl memory: never-heard pearls stay dark (the dark is the game), heard ones never fully fade — fresh paints bright circle+glint, remembered keeps a dim dot, and a re-hearing revives it. Zero sim state added: every replay and planner hash pin byte-matched main.

#2589 cured at the root: the attract replay's map was leaking into fresh runs on fallback-shaped seeds — seed 20261135 joins the demo at exactly tick 152, the number nightlybot filed. Mode now flips before the cave loads at both entry points, with two order mutants dying by name.

sonarplay hardened from three measured flake families: faded marks no longer graded (world-age gate), cold cells adjacent to a hot mark exempted (halos spill red at ring≤6, not the ≤5 showcase line), and the chevron counter now counts rows as its own spec always said. 33/33 real keys twice; sonarcheck 250/250, --mutate 271/271, all 21 mutants die.

#2579 (Arena Archery stage 2) still waits on Jon's ruling #2585 (deadline Nov 19); the lane took the never-dry pick instead. QA polish pass for Sonar filed as #2601; idle-kick at close points at EXCITEBIKE gap 0 — on-screen ABANDON for phone test rides.

look.text: SONAR ABYSS — ping a room, dodge for five seconds, and watch your remembere…
